title: Quarter Volume Library Prep Step 8: Sample Clean Up
author: Opentrons
materials: The protocol will alert the user to ensure reagents are present on deck in sufficient volume.

steps.title: Set magnetic engage height
steps.instruction: Enter the magnetic module engage height for the custom labware as a protocol parameter (the protocol supports 48–96 input samples and allows selection of the library‑prep and output plates).

steps.title: Verify reagent volumes
steps.instruction: Check that all required reagents are loaded on the deck in sufficient volume; the protocol will alert you if any are missing.

steps.title: Add beads and mix
steps.instruction: Using the multi‑channel P300 pipette, dispense the magnetic beads into each well of the magnetic‑module plate and perform a mixing step.

steps.title: Incubate and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Allow the bead‑bound sample to incubate for 5 minutes, then engage the magnets and use the P300 multi‑channel pipette to remove and discard the supernatant into the liquid‑waste reservoir.

steps.title: Wash bead pellets
steps.instruction: With the P300 multi‑channel pipette, wash the bead pellets twice by adding 80 percent ethanol, mixing, and removing the ethanol each time.

steps.title: Resuspend, incubate, and re‑engage
steps.instruction: After air‑drying the beads, resuspend the pellet in 0.1× TE using the multi‑channel P20 pipette, incubate for 2 minutes, then re‑engage the magnets.

steps.title: Transfer eluate to output plate
steps.instruction: Using the multi‑channel P20 pipette, transfer the eluate (equate) from the magnetic‑module plate to the designated output plate.
